name: VRP-UDF Training & Rendering Setup
definition: A neural network-based volume rendering prior used to learn unsigned distance functions (UDFs) and guide Gaussian Splatting optimization by providing dense queries around the UDF zero-level set.
summary: VRP-UDF Training & Rendering Setup uses a differentiable unsigned distance field to regularize 3D Gaussian Splatting, solving surface reconstruction inaccuracies without relying on explicit multi-view stereo consistency.
